# Hazard

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:Hazard`](gmeow-Hazard.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/Hazard>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/risk`](../../slices/risk.md)

A bearer's disposition toward harm — manifested, when it manifests at all, as events of a feared type ([`gmeow:manifestedAsType`](../properties/gmeow-manifestedAsType.md)). A hazard that never manifests is still fully real as a disposition: the first [gufo:Disposition](../../external/terms.md#gufo-disposition) use in GMEOW, and the reason this slice needs no counterfactual machinery. The bearer may be anything that can carry a disposition: a system, an agent, a relationship, an artifact.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md), [`gufo:Disposition`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-disposition)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:Hazard`](gmeow-Hazard.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:RiskFactor`](gmeow-RiskFactor.md), [`gufo:Disposition`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-disposition). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
